text: {"lessons":["My repeated sales of A, D and E after gains felt rewarding, but trimming winners in several rounds may have cut exposure to stocks that kept rising; I should sell according to a clear portfolio plan, not just to lock in a gain.","I added to B and C and later bought A, so I should check that new purchases fit my diversification and risk needs rather than treating cash from sales as money that must be reinvested.","I rarely check or trade, and losses bother me more than equal gains please me; I should set simple rules for reviewing holdings and managing risk so neither fear of a loss nor pleasure in a gain drives impulsive decisions."]}
